#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;
const int MAXN = 250005;

int MOD, n, k, lg, m;
int f[MAXN][18], ans[18], cnt[MAXN], v[MAXN];
int fac[MAXN], ifac[MAXN], inv[MAXN];

inline void add(int *a, int *b, bool fg) {
    for (int i = 0; i < lg; ++i) {
        a[i] += fg ? b[i] : (MOD - b[i]);
        if (a[i] >= MOD) a[i] -= MOD;
    }
}

inline void mul(int *a, int *b) {
    static int c[18];
    memset(c, 0, sizeof(c));
    for (int i = 0; i < lg; ++i) {
        if (!a[i]) continue;
        for (int j = 0; i + j < lg; ++j) {
            c[i + j] = (1LL * a[i] * b[j] + c[i + j]) % MOD;
        }
    }
    memcpy(a, c, sizeof(c));
}

inline void fpm(int *a, int b) {
    memset(ans, 0, sizeof(ans));
    ans[0] = 1;
    while (b) {
        if (b & 1) mul(ans, a);
        b >>= 1;
        if (b) mul(a, a);
    }
    memcpy(a, ans, sizeof(ans));
}

inline int qpow(int a, int b) {
    int res = 1;
    while (b) {
        if (b & 1) res = 1LL * res * a % MOD;
        b >>= 1;
        if (b) a = 1LL * a * a % MOD;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
#ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
    freopen("game.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("game.out", "w", stdout);
#endif

        f[i][cnt[i]] = ifac[i];
